input.short_description: Install and use the godzilla-go SDK to manage pipelines and connectors from Go.
input.body:
Go SDK {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}}

A typed client for the v2 REST API, for Go 1.19+.

Install

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=go get github.com/godzilla-dev/godzilla-go}}

Create a client

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=client.go|language=go|code=package main import "github.com/godzilla-dev/godzilla-go" client := godzilla.NewClient(os.Getenv("GODZILLA_API_KEY"))}}

Create a pipeline

Maps directly onto the Pipelines endpoint — see the Building your first pipeline guide for the concepts.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=create_pipeline.go|language=go|code=pipeline, err := client.Pipelines.Create(ctx, &godzilla.CreatePipelineRequest{\n Name: "ingest-orders",\n SourceConnectorID: "conn_pg_orders",\n DestinationConnectorID: "conn_snowflake_dw",\n})}}

Handling errors with context

The SDK provides rich error types and respects Go's context patterns for timeouts and cancellation:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=error_handling.go|language=go|code=ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)\ndefer cancel()\n\npipeline, err := client.Pipelines.Get(ctx, "pipe_abc123")\nif err != nil {\n if godzilla.IsNotFound(err) {\n // Handle 404\n }\n}}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Structured logging|body_html=

Pass a *log/slog.Logger to WithLogger during client construction to capture request/response details and retries.

}}
